content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: PG Degree/ DNB/ PG Diploma in Medicine Discipline Experience: Minimum 3 Years post qualification experience Age limit: Maximum 65 years (as on 31 October 2026) Other conditions: Candidate should have registered their qualification with any State Medical Council under National Medical Commission (NMC).

content_sections.heading: HAL Physician (General Medicine) Job Description
content_sections.text: Visit the IHC of HAL Koraput on suitable days as per the requirements of the Division for providing treatment to patients on intimation from the Chief of Medical Services (CoMS). Attend emergencies at the IHC, HAL Koraput Division when requested. Maximum visits per week are limited to 2 visits, with a minimum number of 5 hours per visit.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial engagement will be for a period of 2 (Two) years. Can be terminated with one-month notice, in writing, by either side or payment in lieu of notice.

content_sections.heading: How Will HAL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of candidates Interview for shortlisted candidates Interviews may be conducted in person or virtually over video conference mode.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of proof of age (Matriculation Certificate / Birth Certificate) Educational Qualification and marks secured Post Qualification Experience certificates Valid Registration to medical practice in India

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HAL Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Forward the duly filled-in application in prescribed format in A4 size paper by post/courier. Send scanned copy of filled-in applications to official email ID: [email protected] . Make sure it reaches by 12 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Incomplete Application Forms or applications not in prescribed format will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in HAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Physician (General Medicine).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for HAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Attached with notification) and send it to Senior Manager (HR), Industrial Health Centre, HAL Koraput Division, Sunabeda, Koraput District, Odisha, PIN-763002, by post/courier/email, to reach by 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years (as on 31 October 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 16,800 per visit.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PG Degree / DNB / PG Diploma in Medicine Discipline with 3 years experience.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate should have registered their qualification with any State Medical Council under National Medical Commission (NMC).

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of candidates. Interview for shortlisted candidates. Interviews may be conducted in person or virtually over video conference mode.
